title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.  

DP\-COE (Digital Photonics Center of Excellence), being part of Keysight Technologies has the responsibility for developing innovative products in the crucial portfolio segment of Oscilloscopes, Photonics, AWG (Arbitrary Waveform Generator), BERT (Bit Error Rate Tester), Digitizer, Logic Analysis, Protocol Analysis which provide fast, extensive insight and enable engineering teams to do their job faster, with higher quality. We serve our customers in the Computer, Semiconductor, Wireless, Automotive, Storage and Communication, Quantum industries with leading edge products and solutions. Keysight Solution teams work closely with DP\-COE to provide required solutions to these industries.
Responsibilities:

As a Test \& Measurement Software Engineer (AI Solutions), you will develop and integrate software that brings AI\-powered capabilities into our digital measurement instrument products, in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment with international teams. You will work on defined assignments under the direction of the senior engineer on site and the Solutions Architect, delivering reliable, well\-tested, maintainable software through the full development lifecycle. This is a deliberately broad role: expect to move across product features, test automation, evaluation harnesses, and developer tooling depending on what the team needs, which makes it a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build both AI and measurement depth rather than specialize narrowly on day one.  

You will work closely with the senior engineer, Solutions Architect, R\&D Project Manager, Product Management, QA and validation, and other stakeholders to deliver new product offerings and improve existing ones. There will be significant ongoing interaction with our design teams located in the United States and Germany, so the candidate should be a strong team worker and should be able and willing to collaborate across sites and time zones.
Qualifications:
**Essential:*** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science (or equivalent) with strong software engineering skills.
* Typically 4\-5 years of relevant software development experience.
* Proficiency in one or more modern software languages such as C\+\+ or C\#.
* Solid grounding in software design patterns, testing, and debugging, with the ability to work independently on defined assignments.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD pipeline workflows.
* Demonstrated experience delivering software components into production or product environments.
* Familiarity with — and a strong desire to learn — how AI\-powered software is built (e.g., retrieval\-augmented generation and agentic techniques).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent team player, responsive and accountable.
* Self\-starter. Willing and able to quickly learn new applications and technologies.
* Willing and able to collaborate with international teams (US, Europe).
 **Preferred:**  

* Working knowledge of, or hands\-on exposure to, Keysight instruments like oscilloscopes, BERTs or AWGs — or a strong foundation in a closely related measurement or signal\-processing domain with the ability to ramp quickly.
* Experience developing instrument, embedded, or real\-time software, including hardware/software integration or signal\-processing pipelines.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI/ML libraries or agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration toolkits.
* Experience building test automation frameworks or evaluation tooling for non\-deterministic systems.
* Exposure to deploying AI/ML models on edge or embedded platforms.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices and explainability tooling (e.g., SHAP, LIME).
* Atlassian tool experience — Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira.
* Scrum agile software development process background.
* Test\-driven development experience.
  

Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Senior Product Manager, Orders \& Reservations**  



**About the Team**  

Orders \& Reservations sits at the center of Expedia Group's commerce platform — the system of record for every booking and the servicing backbone from purchase through cancellation, change, or refund. The platform supports global B2C travelers, B2B partners, and internal finance and analytics consumers across every line of business and brand.
  

  

**What You Will Do (Roles \& Responsibilities)**

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will help improve the Book\-to\-Serve journey by optimizing purchase, booking, and payment success while reducing Failed Customer Interactions through better validation, orchestration, retry, guidance, and intelligent routing. Specifically, you will:  



  

* Own the end\-to\-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for order management and reservations, translating business and technical goals into measurable outcomes for a highly scalable, business\-critical platform
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design and evolve APIs, distributed systems, and cloud\-based integrations that improve orchestration, retry logic, and intelligent routing across the transaction lifecycle
* Drive down Failed Customer Interactions by leading incident learnings, root\-cause analysis, defect reduction, and monitoring/alerting improvements in partnership with operations and support teams
* Lead cross\-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, analytics, finance, and risk — writing clear PRDs, prioritization frameworks, and delivery plans, and building alignment through executive updates and trade\-off discussions
* Explore and apply AI/ML, LLMs, and intelligent automation (e.g., anomaly detection, synthetic monitoring, agent\-assisted operations) to proactively catch and prevent booking, payment, and servicing failures
Use data, dashboards, and experimentation to continuously track purchase, booking, and payment success rates, identifying friction points across the Shop\-to\-Book\-to\-Serve journey and prioritizing fixes accordingly  
* 

  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Min 7\+ years of product management experience owning complex, platform\-oriented products across booking, orders, reservations, payments, servicing, or transaction lifecycle
* Strong understanding of commerce/booking journeys — supply, payment authorization, fraud, confirmation, cancellations, refunds, and post\-booking servicing
* Proven ability to define product vision, strategy, and roadmaps that drive measurable improvements in success, reliability, and cost metrics for large\-scale systems
* Strong technical fluency (APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, cloud architectures) and ability to partner effectively with engineering
* Demonstrated cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills, including executive updates and influence without direct authority
Strong analytical rigor — using data, experimentation, and root\-cause analysis to guide decisions and reduce Failed Customer Interactions  
* 

  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience with order management systems, reservation platforms, travel/hospitality commerce, marketplaces, or other high\-volume transactional products
* Familiarity with booking and servicing metrics — Purchase Success Rate, Booking Success Rate, Payment Success Rate, authorization success, cancellation rates, refund completion, contact/failure rates
* Experience integrating with suppliers, payment providers, fraud systems, customer\-support tools, finance platforms, or external B2B partners
* Experience building or scaling self\-service servicing capabilities for cancellations, changes, refunds, and trip management
* Experience driving platform cost optimization, telemetry efficiency, cloud economics, or governance programs
* Software engineering, systems architecture, or computer science background, with ability to engage deeply in technical design discussions
* Experience operating products globally across multiple brands, lines of business, markets, currencies, regulatory environments, or customer segments
* MBA or equivalent business education; technical degree or equivalent technical experience
Experience in a fast\-paced environment balancing customer value, commercial outcomes, platform health, and delivery constraints  
* 

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Product Manager – AI, Product & UX
description:
We’re looking for a product thinker who doesn't just manage products.  

We’re looking for someone who **can imagine what the product should become.**  

Someone who can take a messy problem, understand the user, simplify it, sketch the experience, prototype it with AI, work with engineers, launch it and then obsess over whether people actually use it. **This is NOT a traditional PM role.** **We aren't looking for someone whose superpower is:**  

* Writing endless PRDs
* Managing Jira tickets
* Taking stakeholder requirements
* Running status meetings
* Maintaining a roadmap because "that's how we've always done it"

 **We are looking for someone who asks:*** Why does this process exist?
* What problem are we actually solving?
* What would this look like if we built it from scratch today?

 **And increasingly:*** What changes if AI is available as a fundamental capability?

 **What you'll do*** Own products from problem insight prototype build launch iteration
* Understand students, learners, faculty, academic teams and other users deeply
* Turn ambiguous problems into simple product experiences
* Work closely with engineering, design, business and AI teams
* Create user journeys, wireframes and prototypes
* Use AI tools extensively for research, analysis, prototyping and product development
* Identify where AI, agents and automation can fundamentally change a workflow
* Define metrics and use data \+ user feedback to continuously improve the product
* Challenge assumptions including our own
* Decide not only what to build, but also what NOT to build

**What we're looking for**  

* You don't have to be an ML engineer.
* But you should be **AI\-native.**
* You should be comfortable experimenting with LLMs, AI agents, AI prototyping/coding tools and emerging technology and understand enough about them to recognise what is genuinely useful versus what is just hype.
* You should have **strong product and design instincts.**
* You don't need to be a UI designer.
* But you should notice when an experience is confusing, cluttered or unnecessarily complicated.
* You should be able to sketch an idea, build a prototype, put it in front of users and learn.


Most importantly: **You should be able to think.** **We'd particularly like to meet people who have*** 3–7 years of product\-building experience
* Shipped 01 or significantly transformed existing products
* Strong UX/product design sensibility
* Worked closely with engineering and design
* Built or shipped AI\-enabled products
* High ownership and comfort with ambiguity
* Strong analytical and communication skills
* A genuine curiosity about how technology changes human behaviour

 **Great product judgment is.** **What we can offer**  

* You will have meaningful ownership and the opportunity to shape how a modern university approaches **product, technology, AI and the learner experience.**
* If you're someone who would rather **build the prototype than write a 20\-page document explaining why we should build it,** we'd like to hear from you.
* **Apply with your CV \+ 2\-3 products you've worked on that you're genuinely proud of.**
* Bonus points if you can tell us **what you would have done differently today.**

 **About MedhaviOne:**  

MedhaviOne is building India's education\-to\-employment infrastructure: shared standards for skills and credentials that connect institutions, employers and learners.  

We are not an early\-stage startup. The Medhavi Group already has:* 600\+ enterprise partners across 30\+ sectors, including Hyundai, Mahindra, MRF, Daikin, IHG Hotels and the Indian Navy; 650,000\+ learners reached across India
* Its own skills university, Medhavi Skills University, with close to 2,000 students on campus


The base is built. We now need people to build the next businesses on top of it.  

For more information, visit https://medhavione.com **About Medhavi Group:**  

Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill\-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry\-integrated higher education. having trained **6\+ lakh learners** with **70%\+ employability outcomes** and supporting **20,000\+ active students**.* **WISE (Work Integrated Skill\-based Higher Education)** is Medhavi’s flagship initiative, built on the principle of **“Industry on Campus”**, combining academic learning with structured on\-the\-job training.
* Through partnerships with **300\+ leading organisations across 26\+ sectors**, including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Marriott, ITC and Tata Electronics, WISE builds industry\-aligned talent pipelines.
* WISE enables students to graduate with **real work experience and industry\-ready skills**, enhancing employability, workforce productivity, and bridging the industry skill gap.


For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise

title: Global Product Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The HR Digital Product Portfolio is one of the largest and most dynamic portfolios within BCG’s Digital Products Organization, enabling technology across BCG’s HR and People functions. Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.

  

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.

  

* Lead and facilitate requirements discussions with business and technology teams to understand problems, user needs, business value, and the wider impact of proposed changes.
* Document clear product requirements in Jira, translating business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, use cases, and solution options.
* Challenge requests constructively, identifying assumptions, dependencies, risks, unintended consequences, and alternative approaches before solutions are agreed.
* Co\-create solutions with business, technology, QA, and vendor teams, helping bridge functional and technical considerations and supporting the Product Owner with prioritization and delivery readiness.
* Build deep product knowledge and take accountability for changes from requirements through test\-scenario definition, validation, deployment readiness, and rollout.
* Prioritize and investigate assigned production issues, identify likely root causes, and bring the right squad, vendor, or technology expertise together to drive effective resolution.
* Support successful adoption of new functionality by preparing release notes and partnering with Learning and Development and Process Enablement colleagues on user guidance and learning materials where needed.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.
* Build adjacent product and technical skills, including taking on straightforward SaaS configuration and functional enhancement activities where appropriate.

  

What You'll Bring

* 6\+ years of relevant experience in product analysis, business analysis, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills, with confidence to challenge assumptions, identify downstream impacts, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.
* Experience partnering with developers and engineers to bridge functional and technical requirements and translate business intent into implementation\-ready specifications.
* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.
* Experience working with SaaS products and external vendors, with an interest in developing hands\-on configuration and product administration capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence; Talent Acquisition or HR technology experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to ServiceNow, APIs, integrations, MuleSoft, production support, system troubleshooting, or change management is beneficial.

  

Who You'll Work With


You’ll be part of the Candidate Selection squad within BCG’s global Talent Acquisition Product Team.

  

You’ll collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineers, developers, QA, Scrum Leads, SaaS Engineers, Talent Acquisition teams, and external vendors. Depending on the product or change, you may also partner with Legal, Data Protection, and Responsible AI teams.

  

The team works through close business and technology co\-creation, combining BCG\-built solutions with integrated SaaS platforms and strong vendor partnerships across a global network.

  

Additional info


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Senior Digital Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Cross\-Functional Leadership
	+ Build solid partnerships across business, technology, design, analytics, operations, legal, privacy, compliance, and other stakeholder groups
	+ Facilitate alignment on priorities, scope, dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines
	+ Communicate product vision, priorities, decisions, and progress to stakeholders at all levels of the organization
	+ Support governance, operational readiness, and scalable delivery practices
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Digital Strategy, or related roles
* Experience in Agile product delivery, managing product roadmaps, backlogs, and prioritization activities
* Experience using data and metrics to inform product decisions
* Experience managing multiple initiatives and balancing competing priorities
* Demonstrated ability to translate business needs and customer insights into actionable product requirements
* Demonstrated solid analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Demonstrated solid communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross\-functional teams in a highly matrixed environment

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting digital self\-service, web, mobile, contact center, or customer engagement experiences
* Experience with AI\-enabled products, conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, automation, or emerging technologies
* Experience working with enterprise platforms, APIs, integrations, shared services, or scalable digital solutions
* Experience supporting analytics, reporting, measurement, or value realization initiatives
* Experience using tools such as Aha!, Jira, Rally, Power BI, Tableau, Adobe Analytics, or similar platforms
* Healthcare or regulated industry experience
* Familiarity with governance, operational processes, workflow management, or regulatory considerations

 **Why Join Us**


UnitedHealth Group, a Fortune 5 organization, is committed to improving healthcare experiences through innovation and scale. As a Product Manager, you'll play a hands\-on role in building digital solutions that make healthcare finances easier, clearer, and more accessible for millions of consumers.

 **Commitment to Diversity**


We build workplaces that welcome diversity, inclusion, and the strength of underrepresented voices. Every innovation sparks from diversity in perspective

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Product Manager
description:

We need someone who’s built agents with their own hands — not managed AI products from a roadmap. You will work closely with the Solutions Architect, R\&D Project Manager, Product Management, software engineers, QA and validation, and other stakeholders to develop new product offerings and improve existing ones. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science (or equivalent) with strong software engineering skills.
* Minimum 8 years of software development experience, with at least 3 years in a senior software development role.
* Experience in developing a significant software application.

* Strong foundation in software design patterns, system architecture, and performance optimization for complex multi\-threaded or real\-time systems.

* Demonstrated hands\-on experience deploying software components in production environments.
* Familiarity with — and a strong desire to learn — AI data flow, including prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, and multi\-step agent reasoning.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently against architectural direction set by a colleague in another time zone, and to mentor less experienced engineers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent team player, responsive and accountable.
* Self\-starter. Willing and able to quickly learn new applications and technologies.
* Experience in international collaboration (US, Europe).
 **Preferred:**  

* Experience with Keysight instruments like oscilloscopes, BERTs or AWGs — or a strong foundation in a closely related measurement or signal\-processing domain with the ability to ramp quickly.
* Hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration toolkits.
* Experience building multi\-agent systems or custom orchestration layers, including agent roles, tool calls, memory, and reasoning loops.
* Experience deploying AI/ML models on edge or embedded platforms, including model quantization, pruning, and on\-device inference optimization.
* Knowledge of hardware/software integration, FPGA data pipelines, or low\-level driver interfaces relevant to AI\-assisted signal processing.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, explainability tooling (SHAP, LIME, attention visualization), and responsible AI practices.
* Experience implementing secure AI data flows with attention to data integrity and traceability.
* Atlassian tool experience — Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira.

* Test\-driven development experience.
* Prior experience as the senior engineer at a satellite or secondary engineering site.

**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.



For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

title: Strategic Account Manager, Account Management
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


In this role the Account Manager will manage a set of critical seller accounts which contribute to 10%\+ business of the sales organization. She/He will be responsible to develop strong relationships with top sellers in the category and drive improvements in customer facing inputs and achieve category objectives.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Managing the seller relationship by championing the seller’s needs at Amazon. Build strong communication channels at all levels of the seller’s organization, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan.  

* Managing and driving the growth of the seller’s business: Build and execute on a strategic account plan that delivers on key business opportunities for the seller and Amazon.
* Managing key improvement initiatives and projects: Drive new product launches and relationship extensions by partnering with the business development and onboarding teams.
* Work with sellers to improve operational aspects of their business in providing a great consumer experience.
* Analyzing the business: Conduct deep dive analysis and provide routine executive\-level reporting on the seller’s current business and future opportunities. Publish recommendations and action plans based on data.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in account management, brand management, performance marketing, digital marketing, sales or consulting

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of work experience
